measures: how well the combiner recovers real DNO footprints from SIMULATED sensors placed on them, with comms dropouts, backup-fitted sensors and partial faults. Not real-world accuracy. The DNO feed is left out of the calls.
caveats: the negatives are mostly control cells and restored faults, whose simulated sensors never fail, so precision is easy here
a miss is a cell where under 60% of the reporting sensors gasped, as in the simulator's partial faults (one home in three), which the DNO feed covers in the live system

accra_replay.note: real nLine GridWatch sensors, one cell (no coordinates in the data), no DNO footprint to score
